Respects max body size limit and truncates or skips oversized pages

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from crawlberg import scrape, create_engine, CrawlConfig

async def main() -> None:
    engine_config = CrawlConfig(max_body_size=1024, respect_robots_txt=False)
    engine = create_engine(engine_config)
    url = "https://example.com"
    result = await scrape(engine, url)
    print(result.body_size)

asyncio.run(main())
```
